critical_code_review_comments: AdminPanel.jsx is 726 lines — exceeds the 700-line recommended split threshold (flagged in iteration 4 as well). Consider splitting ContentTab, ColorsTab, ImagesTab into sub-components.
InlineEditPopover.jsx uses getBoundingClientRect for positioning which works well but does not account for window resize while popover is open. Minor UX edge case.
EditModeContext handleSave catches all errors and shows a local save warning — appropriate fallback behavior.
FIELD_LABELS map in EditModeContext covers all expected paths. getLabelFor fallback for unmapped paths works via camelCase splitting.
